build_decision: Every public listing, project, guide, city page, professional page, and tool must map to one keyword registry row before drafting or indexing.
required_input: keyword_id, primary keyword, canonical owner, page role, readiness status, legal/source/asset gates
wordpress_surface: keyword_registry admin, editor sidebar, import job
seo_rule: No indexed page without keyword_id and canonical owner.
mobile_acceptance: Registry screens remain readable on laptop; public pages show no registry internals.
screenshot_gate: Capture registry list, edit screen, blocked-publish warning.

build_decision: Build indexable marketplace routes only for canonical money owners: /buy, /rent, /buy/{city}, /rent/{city}, selected neighborhoods and listing detail pages with verified supply.
required_input: page_id, canonical_url_owner, supply count, source freshness
wordpress_surface: theme templates, rewrite rules, sitemap rules
seo_rule: Canonical URLs must be consistent in internal links, sitemap, and canonical tag.
mobile_acceptance: Mobile cards and filters fit 390px without horizontal scroll.
screenshot_gate: Capture /buy, /buy/{city}, and empty canonical city route.

build_decision: Filters improve user navigation but only high-value owner-approved filter combinations become indexable landing pages. Low-value combinations stay noindex or internal search.
required_input: filter taxonomy, query parameter map, search volume, supply threshold
wordpress_surface: listing archive, robots meta, canonical layer
seo_rule: Avoid indexing empty or thin category/filter pages.
mobile_acceptance: Filter drawer opens and closes at 390px; no dead controls.
screenshot_gate: Capture filters closed/open, applied filter, empty result.

build_decision: Every listing card must disclose source, freshness, image status, paid status when relevant, and enough facts to compare without clickbait.
required_input: listing source, updated_at, image_source, price_source, paid placement flag
seo_rule: Card text must not target a separate keyword from the page owner.
mobile_acceptance: Cards remain scannable in one column at 390px.
screenshot_gate: Capture desktop grid and mobile list with source/freshness visible.

build_decision: Do not use generic or unrelated property photos as if they are the real asset. If image proof is weak, show a premium missing-image or concept state.
required_input: official image URL, license/source, asset status, alt text
wordpress_surface: media pipeline, listing card, listing detail
seo_rule: Structured data image must match visible page content and be crawlable.
mobile_acceptance: Image block has stable aspect ratio and no blank beige cards.
screenshot_gate: Capture official image, concept image, missing image.

build_decision: Paid placement is allowed but must be visibly labeled for users and technically qualified for outbound paid links where applicable.
required_input: placement type, advertiser, target URL, disclosure copy
wordpress_surface: listing ranking layer, outbound link renderer
seo_rule: Paid internal ranking must not become hidden manipulative SEO copy.
mobile_acceptance: Labels fit on mobile without covering image or title.
screenshot_gate: Capture paid and non-paid cards side by side.

build_decision: A listing detail page becomes indexable only when it has verified property facts, source freshness, image truth, contact path, and canonical keyword owner.
required_input: property facts, source, price, rooms, sqm, location, media, contact routing
wordpress_surface: listing detail template, schema layer, lead endpoint
seo_rule: One H1, one canonical, schema reflects visible content.
mobile_acceptance: Hero, facts, CTA, and trust note fit first mobile scroll.
screenshot_gate: Capture first viewport, facts table, lead form, missing-media state.

build_decision: City and neighborhood money hubs combine supply, market context, internal links, guides, professionals, tools, and projects without cannibalizing listings.
required_input: city ID, neighborhood ID, supply count, guide owner, tool links, professional links
wordpress_surface: city templates, internal link module, sitemap
seo_rule: Support pages link to the hub; hub links to filtered inventory only when verified.
mobile_acceptance: Mobile sections stack with clear navigation.
screenshot_gate: Capture city hub top, inventory block, guide/professional links.

build_decision: English investor pages explain Israel purchase paths, projects, taxes, financing, remote buying, and concierge routing without duplicating Hebrew money pages blindly.
required_input: language pair, target market, legal review, canonical relationship, hreflang pair
wordpress_surface: EN templates, hreflang sitemap, investor lead forms
seo_rule: Each localized version references itself and alternates correctly; canonical stays same language.
mobile_acceptance: Language switch is visible and does not break RTL/LTR.
screenshot_gate: Capture HE and EN pair plus language switch.

build_decision: Use JSON-LD only when it represents visible page content. Prefer BreadcrumbList, Organization, WebSite, Article/Guide where appropriate, and cautious real-estate entity markup outside Google rich-result promises.
required_input: schema type, visible facts, image URLs, breadcrumbs, organization data
seo_rule: Do not mark up hidden, stale, fake, or unrelated content.
mobile_acceptance: No visual effect required, but page content must match schema facts.
screenshot_gate: Validate sample pages with Rich Results Test after deployment.

build_decision: Marketplace pages need visible freshness and supply thresholds. Empty canonical pages can exist as premium waitlist pages, but thin inventory pages should not be indexed.
required_input: supply count, last updated, feed source, stale threshold
wordpress_surface: listing feed, admin status, archive template
seo_rule: Empty or thin pages are noindex unless approved as strategic money pages with real editorial value.
mobile_acceptance: Empty state is helpful and not deceptive at 390px.
screenshot_gate: Capture enough supply, low supply, zero supply.

build_decision: Every contact action carries page_id, keyword_id, listing_id or project_id, language, source route, selected filters, and placement state.
required_input: analytics events, lead payload, WhatsApp template, form endpoint
wordpress_surface: lead endpoint, analytics layer, CTA components
seo_rule: Measurement must not create indexable parameter URLs.
mobile_acceptance: CTA dock does not cover footer or cards.
screenshot_gate: Capture card CTA, detail CTA, footer with dock.

build_decision: Writers and AI tools may draft only from an approved registry row. Drafts must cite source URLs, choose support role, and link to the canonical money page.
required_input: registry row, source URLs, writer, reviewer, allowed support links
seo_rule: No support article targets the same primary phrase as the money owner.
mobile_acceptance: Admin workflow readable; public copy avoids internal workflow language.
screenshot_gate: Capture blocked draft and approved draft metadata.

build_decision: Outbound paid or advertorial links must use the correct relationship attribute. Normal editorial links stay natural and useful.
required_input: link type, advertiser relationship, URL, anchor text
seo_rule: Paid links are qualified; internal links point to canonical URLs.

build_decision: No marketplace or listing PR ships without screenshots, rendered text scan, link/canonical check, no horizontal overflow, and registry ownership check.
required_input: desktop/mobile screenshots, rendered text, URL metadata, registry match
wordpress_surface: release checklist, QA scripts, evidence folder
seo_rule: QA must prove the broad requirement, not only one happy path.
mobile_acceptance: 390px and desktop screenshots stored in repo.
screenshot_gate: Capture full evidence set for every build slice.
